# PixelSqueeze

> One-click AI photo enhancer. Fix blur, lighting, color, noise, and resolution instantly — free, in your browser, no signup for your first fix.

PixelSqueeze is a web app (also iOS/Android PWA) that automatically enhances photos using AI. Upload any image and PixelSqueeze detects issues (blur, noise, low light, dull color, low resolution, oversized files) and fixes them in a single tap. Ideal for parents, realtors, e-commerce sellers, content creators, and small businesses who need pro-looking photos without editing skills.

## Tools

- [AI Image Upscaler](/tools/ai-image-upscaler): Upscale photos up to 4× without losing quality.
- [Image Enhancer](/tools/image-enhancer): One-click sharpen, denoise, and color correction.
- [Photo Optimizer](/tools/photo-optimizer): Compress and resize photos for social, web, or print.
- [Website Image Compression](/tools/website-image-compression): Optimize every image on a page in bulk.
- [Print-Ready Images](/tools/print-ready-images): Resize and upscale to standard print sizes at 300 DPI.
- [SEO Image Optimizer](/tools/seo-image-optimizer): Auto-generate filenames, alt text, captions, and responsive variants.
